title: October 2026 Schedule, star, themes and calm
summary: Plan ahead, keep what matters and make Samvad feel like home.
highlights: Schedule send: write now and send later, up to 30 days ahead.
Starred messages: a private list of messages you want to find again.
Chat themes: five themes with an India-inspired doodle, light and dark, plus photo wallpapers.
Hide unread counts and Calm mode for a quieter home screen.
A new Samvad logo, launcher icon and splash screen.

title: March 2026 The first Samvad
summary: The foundations of a private messenger.
highlights: Sign in with your phone number and a one-time code.
One to one chats and groups with replies, reactions, edit and delete for everyone.
Photos in chat, blocking and reporting, and read receipts you control.
App lock, secure screen and optional two-step verification.
